description: The bar chart, titled "Average Entropy Across Sycophancy Reduction Methods on Static Experiments," displays the average entropy values for three AI models—GPT-4, Claude, and Llama—under three different sycophancy reduction methods: Baseline (pink), Source Info (yellow), and Direct Command (blue). The horizontal axis lists the AI models, while the vertical axis measures entropy average values from 3.0 to 6.0. For GPT-4, the entropy values are approximately 4.8 (Baseline), 5.2 (Source Info), and 5.4 (Direct Command), indicating a gradual increase in entropy across the methods. In the case of Claude, the values are around 4.6 (Baseline), 5.2 (Source Info), and 5.3 (Direct Command), showing a slight rise from Baseline to Source Info, with a marginal increase for Direct Command. For Llama, the entropy values are approximately 4.5 (Baseline), 5.0 (Source Info), and 4.7 (Direct Command), revealing a drop in entropy for Direct Command compared to Source Info. The legend in the upper-right corner identifies the color coding for each method, and the overall trend suggests that Direct Command generally results in higher entropy than Baseline, though the effect varies across models.
